brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net can you make a little site to practice just the first holdem decision? two random cards, decide whether to stay in or fold and give feedback on correct / incorrect

leave out other parts of the scenario - just stay in or fold
note: built preflop.bisks.net: two random hole cards, stay in or fold, graded against the Chen formula (score 8+ = stay) — no flop, no opponents, just the one decision on repeat with a running streak.
